info.title: PayPal Partner Gateway Setup CLI
info.description: Global .NET tool that sets up PayPal.PartnerGateway in your project automatically: detects whether you're in an ASP.NET Core app, Worker Service, console app, or class library and installs/configures the right package(s) for it - no --framework flag needed. Also includes 'order create/get/capture' commands to exercise the real Orders API straight from the terminal.
